title: Intro call, Kestrel Robotics
subject: Kestrel Robotics
document:
Investor: Great to meet you. Give me the quick version.
Maya: We build autonomous rebar-tying robots for bridge decks and parking structures. We started the company in 2023 in Pittsburgh.
Investor: Where are you on revenue?
Maya: We ended August at $2.4M ARR. Gross margin on the robot-as-a-service contracts is about 58%.
Investor: Customers?
Maya: Five paying customers. Kiewit signed a production contract in July for three sites. Skanska is in a paid pilot on one deck in Queens. We're talking to Turner but nothing signed.
Investor: Team and cash?
Maya: We're 22 people. We have $6.1M in the bank and burn about $380K a month, so roughly 16 months of runway.
Investor: IP?
Maya: Two granted patents and four pending.
Investor: The website says you're in 40 states.
Maya: That's aspirational, honestly. Today we operate in six.
